title: What If You Felt a Moonquake? The Moon Rings Like a Bell

scenes.text: What if the ground under your boots on the Moon started shaking? It would not stop quickly.
Apollo seismometers recorded 28 shallow moonquakes, some as strong as magnitude 5.5.
An Earth quake fades in under two minutes. A shallow moonquake can shake for about ten.
When NASA crashed the Apollo 12 lunar module, the Moon trembled for about an hour.
Earth's moisture soaks up seismic waves. The Moon is dry, cold and rigid.
Nothing damps the vibrations, so scientists say the Moon rings like a bell.
